item.title: PROPOSED CHANGES: Decision pending on plans to convert Watford church into mosque
item.description: A long-closed church in North Watford could reopen with a potential new role after updated plans to turn the current place of worship into a mosque were submitted. The application relates to the former Leavesden Road Baptist Church, which closed its doors back in 2021. Initial plans were lodged in November 2025 but temporarily removed from Watford Borough Council’s planning system in December 2025 while further information was requested. Further […]Read More →
